description: Source code for the MtpDevice class handling Media Transfer Protocol (MTP) device interactions in Android, including device opening, session management, object handling, and data transfer.

classes.name: MtpDevice
classes.description: Class managing interactions with an MTP device, including session management, object handling, and data transfer.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Static method to open and initialize an MTP device given device name and file descriptor.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the device and releases resources.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information.

methods.name: getStorageIDs
methods.description: Gets list of storage IDs.

methods.name: getStorageInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific storage.

methods.name: getObjectHandles
methods.description: Gets object handles for specified storage, format, and parent.

methods.name: getObjectInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific object.

methods.name: getThumbnail
methods.description: Gets thumbnail data for an object.

methods.name: sendObjectInfo
methods.description: Sends object information to the device.

methods.name: sendObject
methods.description: Sends an object to the device.

methods.name: deleteObject
methods.description: Deletes an object from the device.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Retrieves parent handle of an object.

methods.name: getStorageID
methods.description: Retrieves storage ID of an object.

methods.name: getObjectPropsSupported
methods.description: Gets supported object properties for a format.

methods.name: getDevicePropDesc
methods.description: Gets device property description.

methods.name: setDevicePropValueStr
methods.description: Sets device property value as string.

methods.name: getObjectPropDesc
methods.description: Gets object property description.

methods.name: getObjectPropValue
methods.description: Retrieves value of an object property.

methods.name: readObject
methods.description: Reads object data and writes to callback or file descriptor.

methods.name: readPartialObject
methods.description: Reads a partial object starting at offset.

methods.name: readPartialObject64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit offset partial object.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends an MTP operation request.

methods.name: sendData
methods.description: Sends data associated with a request.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Reads data from device, handling headers and data packets.

methods.name: readResponse
methods.description: Reads response from device.

methods.name: submitEventRequest
methods.description: Submits an event request.

methods.name: reapEventRequest
methods.description: Reaps an event request response.

methods.name: discardEventRequest
methods.description: Discards an event request.
